limitations: Diagnostic after opening the holdout; not another independent evaluation.
Both arms exclude multi-pose frames and use identical v4-smoothed joints; no pose interpolation.
Constant ID is a counterfactual, not verified identity ground truth. An isolated background pose can still be a different person.
Absences longer than 0.5 seconds still expire motion history. This does not measure a fully corrected landmark/occlusion system.
Do not compare the restricted ordinary-ID baseline directly to the full candidate score.
